title: A day at the Agentic AI Lab

segments.narration: Step inside the Agentic AI Lab and see a day of creation unfold.
Students collaborate at bright workstations, turning ideas into real multi‑agent AI projects.
Learning happens as they code, test, and continuously improve their agents.
Quick iterations spark fresh insights, and each test brings the system closer to success.
The lab buzzes with energy, as ideas flow and teammates share feedback instantly.
By the afternoon, prototypes are running, showcasing the power of coordinated AI.
Join us, build your own multi‑agent AI, and shape the future together.
